name: Standing up ends Eat Provisions, which must remain seated (#11552)
contract: Eat Provisions (spell 901543, used by the Sack of Regenerating Provisions, item 450586) reads "Eat your
provisions, restoring health and mana every 3 sec for 25 sec while out of combat. Must remain seated while
eating.". A spell that must remain seated ends when its caster stands up, as the stock Food spells do. A
level 30 Chronomancer eats the provisions out of combat, then asks the server to stand with
CMSG_STANDSTATECHANGE, which the client sends when the player moves or presses the stand key. The eating aura
must be gone afterwards. The scenario measures the aura, not the animation: no stand state metric reads a player.

steps.label: fixture: a Sack of Regenerating Provisions
Eat for a moment while seated
The aura is still active while seated
